errors.evidence: The description claims that the dark blue sector ('Няколко пъти месечно') is 9.1%, but there is no percentage label for this sector in the pie chart. This value is invented.

The description claims that the red sector ('Всеки месец') is 9.1%, but there is no percentage label for this sector in the pie chart. This value is invented and also contradicts the visual evidence, as the red slice is visibly the smallest.

errors.text_span: Във всеки сектор е посочен процент, представящ неговия дял.
errors.evidence: This statement is false. Only four of the six sectors have percentage labels inside them. The sectors for 'Няколко пъти месечно' (dark blue) and 'Всеки месец' (red) do not have percentage labels.

errors.text_span: Секторите изглеждат подредени по низходящ размер
errors.evidence: The sectors are not in strict descending order. There are two pairs of sectors with equal values (36.4% and 36.4%; 9.1% and 9.1%). Describing the order as simply 'descending' is an over-generalization.
